meta.defaultDescription: Goalsquare combines a proven training method with digital tools, 1,250+ drills and intelligent session planning for goalkeeper coaches.

hero.subtitle: One method. Intelligent tools. Every session under control.
hero.lead: Goalsquare combines a proven training method with digital tools, 1,250+ drills and intelligent session planning.

how.title: How Goalsquare works.
how.subtitle: Four steps from the method to the pitch.

steps.title: Learn the method
steps.text: Understand the structure and principles of the Goalsquare method.
steps.detail: The Goalsquare method is a curriculum for modern, concept-driven goalkeeper training. It consists of 5 elements that build on each other but also interlock. Alongside goalkeeper-specific attributes, a large part of the method is dedicated to the footballing skills of the goalkeeper.

steps.title: Select drills
steps.text: Pick the right exercises from the library.
steps.detail: Choose from more than 1,250 goalkeeper drills with detailed diagrams, descriptions, age level and required equipment. Every drill is colour-coded by element and carries a base difficulty that can be increased or reduced through variations.

steps.title: Plan the session
bullets: BASIC Edition – software for fast, simple session planning
PRO Suite – professional software for the goalkeeper coach
PLAN – online portal and app for intelligent, AI-assisted planning
steps.detail: At your desk or on the move: with BASIC, PRO or the new PLAN online session planner you structure duration, focus and load in a few minutes.

steps.title: Take it on the pitch
steps.text: Access drills and notes on your phone during training.
bullets: Session plan directly on your mobile device
steps.detail: The free mobile app syncs your planned sessions and drill animations straight to the pitch – including notes and feedback.

elements.title: The 5 core elements.
elements.subtitle: Five elements that build on each other and interlock – from isolated basic technique to game-realistic competition under pressure.
elements.hint: Select an element to open its training content.
elements.curriculumText: Every element contains dedicated drills for each age and performance level, so every goalkeeper can be developed individually. The difficulty can be adapted to the level of the keeper.

s3.title: 3. Prices and Payment Terms

s4.text: Digital products, such as software licenses or drill packs, are delivered via email or made available for download immediately after the payment is successfully processed. Physical products are shipped to the address provided during checkout.

digital.title: Digital Products & Downloads

physical.title: Physical Goods (USB Sticks / Data Media)

deliveryTimes.text: Digital products are available instantly after payment. Physical orders are processed within 1-2 business days. Delivery within the EU typically takes 3-7 business days, while international shipping may vary based on the local carrier.
